title: Named warp destinations
hypothesis: Naming a door inline only from a name the game displays (PROF. BIRCH'S HOUSE 1F instead of map 1/2), while withholding internal-only names, stops the model mistaking the rival's door for Birch's lab without leaking future place names, so more runs enter the rival house and meet the rival.
notes: Requested 2026-10-14 after the Think Fast 2x2: runs called the (14,8) door 'Birch's Lab' or 'Route 101' and four of seven entrants left May's house without meeting her, three saying they were in the wrong building. Revised 2026-10-18 before any trial: internal map-table names are no longer sufficient evidence for model-facing text. Both arms enable displayed-place-names-v1; the candidate may use only those game-displayed, save-specific sign names. The set truck warp therefore stays dynamic destination instead of revealing LITTLEROOT TOWN before MOM names it. The definition edit makes the old approval stale; no measured trial has started. Queued ahead of world-destinations (operator).
